briefing: This is {PATRON}. A Python is lifting off from {HERE} today, and she wants a gun riding beside her.
Take her out, hold formation, and see her safe into range at the far station.
Do that, and you will find the credit good when you dock back at {HERE}.

cover.arrive: Escort the Python to {TARGET} and hold formation until she reaches station range
cover.success: The Python docked safe at {TARGET}, and {PAY} lands in your account
cover.fail: The Python never reached {TARGET}, and the fee of {PAY} stays unpaid

dossier.lead: {PATRON} wants a word about work waiting at {WORLD}.

rumour.far: Word says {PATRON} at {WORLD} still needs a fighter to ride escort.
rumour.near: {PATRON} sends word from {WORLD} that the Python still waits for her escort.

dossier.news: {PATRON} needs a pilot to fly escort out of {WORLD}.

story.opening: On day {DAY}, the commander signed on to escort a Python out of {WORLD}.

closing.complete: By day {DAY}, the Python reached {WORLD} safe, and the escort job was closed.
closing.fail: By day {DAY}, the escort had failed, and the commander left {WORLD} with nothing to show.

cover.success: By day {DAY}, the Python docked safe at {WORLD}, and the escort was complete.
cover.targetDestroyed: By day {DAY}, the Python was destroyed near {WORLD}, and the escort had failed.
cover.targetEscaped: By day {DAY}, the Python jumped clear of {WORLD} alone, and the escort was lost.
cover.failed: By day {DAY}, the escort broke down before reaching {WORLD}, and the job was over.

dossier.title: A Gun Beside Her
